title: Sun and moon letters: when the lam of 'al-' disappears

bigIdea.text: 'Al-' means 'the'. Before 14 letters (the sun letters) its lam is not said and the next letter is doubled. Before the other 14 (the moon letters) the lam is said clearly, with sukun.

proper.text: Lam shamsiyya ('sun lam'): before ت ث د ذ ر ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ل ن, the lam of 'al-' is silent and the next letter takes a shadda, so you hear it twice. The word for 'the sun' in 75:9 shows it.
Lam qamariyya ('moon lam'): before the other 14 letters, ء ب ج ح خ ع غ ف ق ك م و ه ي, the lam is pronounced with sukun: 'al-'. The word for 'the moon' in 75:9 shows it.
The mushaf shows you which is which: a sun lam has no mark and the next letter has a shadda; a moon lam carries a sukun.
Starting on 'al-', you say the joining hamza as 'a' (lesson 24) and then follow the sun or moon rule. Joining from the word before, the hamza drops, and with a sun letter the lam drops too.

visual.caption: The 14 sun letters: after them the lam of al- is silent and the letter is doubled.

memoryHook.text: Sun letters swallow the lam; moon letters let it shine.

extras.text: Why? The sun letters are made close to where lam itself is made, so the lam blends into them. The moon letters are made elsewhere, so the lam stays clear.

note.text: Sun, then moon, side by side: the first lam is silent (ش doubled); the second is said with sukun.
ن is a sun letter: the lam is silent and ن is doubled.
ف is a moon letter: the lam has a sukun and is said.

drills.prompt: Sun letters: اَلتَّ اَلشَّ اَلنَّ (at-ta, ash-sha, an-na). No lam; double the letter.
Moon letters: اَلْبَ اَلْقَ اَلْكَ (al-ba, al-qa, al-ka). A clear lam with sukun.
Mixed: say each letter after 'al-' and decide sun or moon: ر · م · س · ع · ن · ف

questions.q: Before a sun letter, what happens to the lam of 'al-'?
options: It is silent and the next letter is doubled
explain: Lam is not a madd letter.
It merges into the next letter; it doesn't change into ن.

questions.q: Which letter is a SUN letter?
explain: Right: the lam merges into ن.

questions.q: Which letter is a MOON letter?
explain: Right: the lam is said before ك.

questions.q: How does the mushaf show a sun lam?
options: The lam has no mark and the next letter has a shadda
explain: A sukun on the lam means a moon lam.
The lam of 'al-' never carries a vowel.
It is written full size; it just isn't said.

questions.q: How many sun letters are there?
Why are they called 'sun' and 'moon' letters?
options: After the words for 'the sun' and 'the moon': one has a sun letter after al-, the other a moon letter
Because they are read at different times of day
explain: Right: both words appear side by side in 75:9.
Time of day has nothing to do with it.
Heaviness is a different idea; ت and ن are light sun letters.
Moon letters are pronounced; it is the sun lam that is silent.

questions.q: Before a moon letter, the lam of 'al-' is…
explain: With a moon letter nothing is doubled.
The lam of 'al-' has no vowel.

questions.q: Which of these is a sun letter?
Which of these is a moon letter?
In 75:9 the words for 'the sun' and 'the moon' stand side by side. What do you hear?
options: The sun word: no lam, ش doubled; the moon word: a clear lam
explain: The first lam is a sun lam, so it is silent.
The second lam is a moon lam, so it is said.

questions.q: You start reading on a word with a sun lam (like 'ash-sh…'). How do you begin?
options: Straight on the doubled letter, without 'a'
explain: With a sun letter the lam is silent.
When you start, you must say the joining hamza.

questions.q: When 'al-' comes before a ل, is that ل a sun or a moon letter?
options: Sun: the two lams merge into one doubled lam
explain: Right: ل is one of the 14 sun letters.
The first lam merges into the second.
Every letter is either sun or moon.
The group never depends on the vowel.

questions.q: With a sun lam, which of these must you NOT do?
options: Say 'a' when you start on the word
explain: Right: the sun lam is silent.
Doubling the next letter is correct.
Saying the joining hamza when you start is correct.
Skipping the lam is exactly right.

remnote: Sun letters (14) == ت ث د ذ ر ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ل ن: the lam of al- is silent, the next letter doubled
Moon letters (14) == ء ب ج ح خ ع غ ف ق ك م و ه ي: the lam of al- is said with sukun
How the mushaf marks a sun lam == No mark on the lam, shadda on the next letter
